## Story DD Coverage
- Documentation of the new wrapper + SC5(c) carve-out (contract-preserving behavior change documented).

## Implementation Notes

Update `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md`:
- New section: 'Integration-review provenance skip'
- Document the wrapper llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh + exit-code routing (0/1/2/3 \xe2\x86\x92 skip/full/full/skip-acknowledged)
- Document the check-run summary format ('Covered by sub-PR reviews: PR#<num>:<sha>, ...')
- Cross-link to verify-session-provenance.sh contract
- Mention SC5(c) carve-out: ci.yml:llm-review's invocation surface is unchanged; execution outcome (run vs. skip) is now data-dependent. The carve-out applies because the alternative (always running) is the regression being fixed.

(Full ADR for SC5(c) is owned by S_docs; this task only adds the cross-reference + brief mention.)

Doc-router Gate 2 fired (existing reference doc). Emit DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION.
